patch_description: Retain count three as the default: its measured mean error was 3.36 versus 3.47 for the broader reduction rule. The alternative executed count two only occasionally, yet recovery effects varied by case; case_013 interval-end error increased from 0.977 to 2.490. Narrow its exception to broad swarm coverage accompanied by a strict observed fitness improvement, excluding small deteriorations previously allowed. This tests whether that narrower condition supports two relocations; improved performance remains unmeasured.
